channel.title: Alex Huang
channel.description: Senior Engineer & Technical Consultant | 8+ Years | Salesforce · Apex · LWC · DevOps · AI Integration. End-to-end solution delivery specialist across public sector, healthcare, and enterprise environments. Expert in scalable solution architecture, Apex/LWC development, DevOps/CI/CD, and integration patterns — with a strong track record of transforming complex business requirements into production-ready systems.

item.title: I Distilled Myself Into a Bot So I Could Take Three Weeks Off
item.description: It started as a way to survive three weeks of annual leave without Teams pinging me: distil what I know into a bot that answers as me. Then every role I wanted asked for RAG, so I rebuilt it in the open. How Ask Alex works, on Cloud Run, Vertex AI, and pgvector.

item.title: I Built a Claude Code Harness for a Salesforce Project. Here's What's Inside.
item.description: Most Claude Code harnesses are JS/TS-shaped. Here's one built for a Salesforce Apex/LWC monorepo: hooks, CLAUDE.md, skills, MCP, and the scars that shaped it.

item.title: Turn Any Doc into an Interactive Web Experience, in One Line
item.description: I built a Claude Code skill that takes any article and turns it into a polished, interactive single-file HTML page. 10 interaction models, 5 design directions, zero frontend code required.

item.title: 从零开始免费部署你的个站，只需要一个下午。以及为何你也该试试
item.description: 记录我用一个下午时间，从零搭建并部署个人网站 alex-huang.dev 的完整过程——工具链：ChatGPT → Gemini → Claude Code → GitHub Pages，实际用时约 4-5 小时。

item.title: Build and Deploy Your Personal Site from Scratch, for Free, in One Afternoon — and Why You Should Give It a Go
item.description: A full account of how I built and deployed alex-huang.dev in a single afternoon — starting from nothing — using ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude Code, and GitHub Pages.

item.title: Shipping US Tax Into a Live AU/NZ Salesforce Org Without Breaking It
item.description: The hard parts of bringing US venues onto an existing multi-region Salesforce platform: orchestrating asynchronous tax calculation around a black-box managed package, resolving UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW contention I couldn't see the source of, region-gating automation, and shipping deltas safely into a live org, without disrupting the AU/NZ booking engine.

item.title: Making Salesforce the System of Record for Funlab's US Business
item.description: How I led the Salesforce engineering that moved Funlab's US operation off a separate booking platform and onto the org that already ran Australia and New Zealand: US tax compliance, end-to-end booking and document automation, and net-new US brands, with no disruption to the live AU/NZ business.

item.title: Funlab's Salesforce Digital Transformation: From Go-Live to 200% Revenue Growth
item.description: How I joined Funlab as sole in-house Salesforce developer, took full technical ownership of a live global platform, and built the LWC booking wizard that drove 200% online revenue growth.

item.title: Digitising NSW Police Force's Public Assembly Notice: LWC on Experience Cloud
item.description: How I led the LWC development to digitalise the NSW Police Force's paper-based Public Assembly notice form into a Salesforce Experience Cloud community portal — deploying 180+ components end-to-end.

item.title: WA Health Vaccine Management: Cutting User Provisioning from 23 Minutes to 3
item.description: How I helped build WA Health's COVID-19 Vaccine Management System on Salesforce — including an automation that cut user provisioning time from 23 minutes to 3 minutes per account.

item.title: ACH Group Salesforce Implementation: Full Lifecycle Delivery in Aged Care
item.description: My experience on the full lifecycle ACH Group Salesforce implementation at Deloitte — from mobilisation and requirements through data migration, system testing, and go-live support in a regulated aged care environment.

item.title: Automating Office 365 Group Provisioning with Microsoft PowerApps
item.description: A Microsoft PowerApps form that automates Office 365 group creation — auto-generating email addresses, enforcing naming conventions, and connecting to SharePoint and Teams.

item.title: BreatheVIC: A Full-Stack Pollen & Air Quality Tracker for Victoria
item.description: A full-stack web application built for pollen-allergy sufferers in Victoria — integrating real-time air quality data, pollen maps, forecast subscriptions, and community plant sighting reports.

item.title: Visualising Victoria's Road Crashes: An R Shiny Data Exploration App
item.description: An interactive R Shiny dashboard exploring five years of VicRoads crash data, featuring speed-zone analysis, severity mapping, and road-type breakdowns.

item.title: Teaching Binary with Gesture Control: A Leap Motion + Unity App
item.description: A Unity/C# educational app that uses Leap Motion hand-tracking to teach binary-to-decimal number conversion through physical gesture interaction.

item.title: Building PuzzleXPuzzle: A 10×10 Block Puzzle Game in Swift
item.description: How I built PuzzleXPuzzle — a 10×10 block puzzle mobile game in Swift for iOS, featuring normal and special-power piece removal mechanics.
